keyFindings.description: Rule 8's new text says no-cache is an input 'which caches but cannot change the version'; no-cache turns setup-bun's cache off (setup-bun@0c5077e action.yml 'Disable caching of bun executable'). This is the only written statement of rule 8 and it is prose this pull request wrote (AC5).

Round 2 made two lines contradict rule 8: the script comment guards against a wrapper 'given a second input' and the test label says 'any extra input on the wrapper fails', while the shipped wrapper passes no-cache as a second input and line 361 admits it.
